name: armorpaint
one_liner: Software for painting realistic textures directly onto 3D models, similar in purpose to expensive professional tools used by game and film studios.
buyer: An indie game developer or freelance 3D artist who needs professional-grade texture painting but can't afford (or wants an alternative to) Substance Painter's subscription.
business_use_cases: A freelance 3D artist uses it as their primary paid texturing tool for client game-asset commissions, saving on software licensing costs.
An indie game studio standardizes on it project-wide to avoid recurring Substance Painter subscription fees across a whole art team.
A 3D-art educator builds a paid tutorial course teaching game texturing specifically using this free tool as an accessible alternative for students.

money_ideas.idea: The project itself already sells paid pre-built binaries to fund development, while source stays free — a proven model worth studying.
Build and sell texture packs, brushes, or plugins compatible with it to the indie game-dev community.

steal_this: Create and sell a curated pack of game-ready texture presets/brushes for it, marketed to indie devs looking to avoid Substance Painter subscriptions.
